title: Pressure Inez
why: Take 1 has the most life. Her wrong guess about the Bureau shows the debt, and "Smile, people can see" makes the visible threat something the Fixer has a reason to say [5a29be8544e336060f678471]. Its ending also lands the face fact [3c23187f33c3d2fe2bc9e157].
changes: Removed 'affair' and 'Table six'. The Fixer now says only 'you and Okafor' and 'the Office could learn', which keeps it gentle and adds no invented detail.
Made each line force the next: 'Who else knows?' gets 'Only us', and 'They'd have him off that door' gets 'About a minute off it', so the ask answers her fear.
Replaced 'because you've scared me' with 'I'm too scared to say no', which gives agreement, fear and resentment in one line. Added 'I'm sorry' so the Fixer takes no pleasure in it.

Conflict for Aster, not used in the scene: the GDD says his café stop before his shift is to see her [e1dd761142af169bfd1cc0d3], but the sheet says they're never together unless she calls him. The scene states neither.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If you're from the Bureau, the loan waits on my tips.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau, I'm sorry. It's about you and Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who told you that? Who else knows?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Only us. The Office could learn, though. Smile, people can see.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: They'd have him off that door. What do you want?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: About a minute off it. When I telephone, you call him over.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'm too scared to say no. I won't forget your face.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No, you won't. If you're ever questioned, you could describe it.

learned: Inez knows the Fixer's face now.
